content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 2025 (e.g., 2025-03-07, 2025-01-16/17) — adjust downward bias for recent periods.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 2025-03-07, 2025-01-17) — reduce forecast after peak by 5–10% to avoid overshoot.
- Tends to lag in mean reversion — forecast should align with 30-day moving average of history, not just last 30 days.
- Overly optimistic in low-price regimes (e.g., 2024-06-17/18) — cap forecast at 10% above recent 7-day average to avoid overcorrection.
- High volatility in 2025-01-16/17 suggests model overreacts to short-term noise — apply smoothing filter (e.g., 5-day moving average) before forecasting.
